description: This Java class 'AcknowledgementForwarderActorStarter' is responsible for starting and managing acknowledgment forwarder actors within an Akka actor system. It provides mechanisms to create, verify, and handle acknowledgment requests, including generating unique correlation IDs and handling duplicate actor names related to acknowledgment processing within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: AcknowledgementForwarderActorStarter
classes.description: A helper class to start and manage acknowledgment forwarder actors, handling acknowledgment requests, correlation IDs, and actor creation logistics.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of AcknowledgementForwarderActorStarter with given context, entity ID, signal, acknowledgement configuration, and acknowledgment label predicate.

methods.name: getAllowedAckRequests
methods.description: Returns the set of acknowledgment requests allowed for this actor starter, filtered based on the signal and predicate.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Attempts to start an acknowledgment forwarder actor and returns an Optional containing the ActorRef if successful.

methods.name: getConflictFree
methods.description: Generates a conflict-free correlation ID and attempts to start an acknowledgment forwarder actor with it, retrying if necessary.

methods.name: joinPrefixAndCounter
methods.description: Joins a prefix and counter into a combined correlation ID string.

methods.name: parseCorrelationId
methods.description: Parses the correlation ID from headers to extract prefix and counter components.

methods.name: startAckForwarderActor
methods.description: Creates and starts an acknowledgment forwarder actor with provided headers.

methods.name: getDuplicateCorrelationIdException
methods.description: Builds an exception indicating duplicate correlation ID error.

methods.name: declineAllNonDittoAckRequests
methods.description: Replies with NACK acknowledgments for all acknowledgment requests with labels that are not Ditto-specific.

methods.name: getNack
methods.description: Creates a NACK acknowledgment object for a given label with exception details.

methods.name: isNotBuiltIn
methods.description: Checks if an acknowledgment request is not a built-in acknowledgment.

methods.name: isNotTwinPersisted
methods.description: Checks if acknowledgment request label is not 'TWIN_PERSISTED'.

methods.name: isNotLiveResponse
methods.description: Checks if acknowledgment request label is not 'LIVE_RESPONSE'.

methods.name: isLiveSignal
methods.description: Determines if the signal is a live signal based on topic channel.

methods.name: hasEffectiveAckRequests
methods.description: Determines if the signal has effective acknowledgment requests based on message type and channel.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Utility to check if a string represents a number starting from a specific index.
